## Conference Presentations

```{r cv-conferences, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

conf_path <- if (file.exists("../speaking/conferences.xlsx")) {
  "../speaking/conferences.xlsx"
} else {
  "speaking/conferences.xlsx"
}

confs <- read.xlsx(conf_path) |>
  arrange(-Year, -Month)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(confs))) {
  r <- confs[i, ]
  if (is.na(r$Title)) next
  type_str <- if (is.na(r$Type)) {
    "Upcoming"
  } else if (grepl("oral", r$Type, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "Talk"
  } else {
    "Poster"
  }
  date_str <- if (!is.na(r$Month)) {
    sprintf("%02d/%d", as.integer(r$Month), as.integer(r$Year))
  } else {
    as.character(r$Year)
  }
  cat(sprintf(
'<div class="cv-entry">
<div class="cv-conf-title">%s (%s)</div>
<div class="cv-entry-date">%s</div>
</div>
<div class="cv-conf-venue">%s &middot; %s</div>\n\n',
    r$Title, type_str, date_str, r$Code_Name, r$Location
  ))
}
```
